new_people.name: Rylan Brantl
new_people.fate_detail: Dismissed from the MU neurosurgery residency in 2013. Employment as a resident ran 1 Jul 2008 to 30 Jun 2013; he says he was made to repeat PGY-4 despite passing the written boards in 2011 and was cut in the fifth year of a six-year program. His post-residency job offer was rescinded; he later worked as a general practitioner in North Dakota (HKM). Sued the UM Curators in 2018 (W.D. Mo. 2:18-cv-04130), dismissed 2019. Did not complete neurosurgery training = attrition. 'left_other' because he practises as a GP (no evidence of another residency); switched_specialty is also possible

notes: Brantl was on the muhealth 2010-11 roster (PGY-3) but not held after the gap. Columbia Missourian and Becker's articles on the suit returned 429/403, and the Missouri appellate opinion (courts.mo.gov id=170699) returned 403. The 1 Jul 2008 to 30 Jun 2013 dates come from the search summary of the court record; HKM and KRCG confirm 2008-2013 and dismissal. Hiser: Doximity snippet says MU residency 2006-2012 (lead only). Paullus: search snippet (US News, not opened) says 2006-2011, so he graduated before the gap. Muzinich: no trace found; still a possible unseen leaver.
